interpretation_layers.sign_level: Sagittarius Moon represents optimistic, freedom-loving emotional nature. Emotions expressed through exploration and seeking meaning.

interpretation_layers.degree_level: 10°14' Sagittarius - First decan ruled by Saturn. Emotional discipline in expansion, structured optimism.

major_aspects_detailed.interpretation: Harmony between conscious will and emotional nature. Easy expression of feelings, emotional support for identity. Natural flow between action and feeling.
Tension between emotions and thinking. Emotional reactions may cloud rational thought. Learning to integrate feelings with logic.
Harmonious communication in relationships. Artistic or diplomatic expression. Pleasant social interaction, aesthetic appreciation.
Tension between love and action. Relationship conflicts or passion/challenge dynamic. Learning to balance cooperation with assertion.
Opportunity for energetic expansion. Courage combined with optimism. Action supported by faith and opportunity.
Tension between expansion and restriction. Optimism vs. pessimism conflicts. Balancing faith with reality.
Structures meeting innovation. Tradition vs. revolution. Generation-defining aspect (1970s). Breaking old structures.
Revolutionary ideals combined with spiritual vision. Another generation-defining aspect. Idealistic innovation.
Spiritual transformation. Collective unconscious meets power transformation. Generation-defining aspect.
Transformative support for evolutionary direction. Power to manifest destiny. Natural alignment with karmic growth.

conjunctions_special_emphasis.interpretation: Emotional spirituality, intuitive feelings, compassionate sensitivity. Strong artistic and spiritual emotional nature. Psychic receptivity in communication.
Abundant love, generosity, artistic talent. Expansive approach to relationships and beauty. Spiritual romance and creative expansion.
Disciplined action, restricted energy, perseverance. Controlled assertiveness with responsibility. Structured communication and teaching.
Spiritual expansion, inspired vision, idealistic growth. Strong artistic-spiritual synthesis. Visionary optimism.

heliacal_rising_star.astrological_meaning: Last star to complete its 'allt' phase before birth. Indicates themes that will emerge in youth.

heliacal_setting_star.mythology: Arabic: 'Tail of the Lion'. Associated with pride, leadership, but also downfall.
heliacal_setting_star.astrological_meaning: Last star to complete its 'cp' phase before birth. Indicates themes of later years.

rising_parans.description: Stars rising or planets at rising during birth

star_details.name: Fomalhaut (α Piscis Austrini)
star_details.meaning: Royal star of Persia. Artistic genius, spiritual insight, but danger of isolation.

entries.interpretation: Sun rising with Fomalhaut rising indicates artistic or spiritual gifts emerging in youth, but potential for isolation or being misunderstood.
Moon rising as Venus culminates suggests emotional nature influenced by Venusian qualities: love, beauty, harmony in youth.

star_details.name: Pollux (β Geminorum)
star_details.meaning: The immortal twin. Courageous, combative, but honorable.

entries.interpretation: Mercury rising as Pollux culminates suggests communication style influenced by courage and combativeness in youth.

star_details.name: Ras Algethi (α Herculis)
star_details.meaning: Head of the Kneeler. Success through effort, artistic talent, but potential for scandal.

entries.interpretation: Venus rising as Ras Algethi is at lower culmination suggests love nature influenced by themes of effort, artistry, with caution around scandal.
Saturn rising as Pluto culminates suggests discipline and structure (Saturn) influenced by transformation and power themes (Pluto) in youth.

star_details.name: Altair (α Aquilae)
star_details.meaning: Flying eagle. Courage, ambition, swiftness, but danger of impulsiveness.

entries.interpretation: Saturn rising as Altair sets suggests structured ambition with Aquilan qualities of swiftness and courage in youth.

culminating_parans.description: Stars culminating or planets at culmination during birth

entries.interpretation: Sun culminating as Pollux sets suggests public identity influenced by Pollux's martial qualities during prime years.
Venus culminating as Moon rises suggests love life and values reaching peak influenced by lunar qualities during prime.

star_details.name: Alnilam (ε Orionis)
star_details.meaning: String of pearls. Ambition, leadership, organizational ability, but danger of arrogance.

entries.interpretation: Mars culminating with Alnilam culminating suggests action and drive at peak influenced by leadership and organizational themes.

star_details.name: Diadem (α Comae Berenices)
star_details.meaning: Berenice's Hair. Artistic talent, devotion, but potential for sacrifice.

entries.interpretation: Mars culminating as Diadem sets suggests action influenced by artistic devotion and potential sacrifice themes.

star_details.name: Sadalmelik (α Aquarii)
star_details.meaning: Lucky star of the king. Spiritual insight, humanitarianism, but unconventional success.

entries.interpretation: Mars culminating as Sadalmelik rises suggests drive influenced by spiritual and humanitarian themes during prime.

star_details.name: Alderamin (α Cephei)
star_details.meaning: The right arm. Success through writing, speaking, or intellectual pursuits.

entries.interpretation: Neptune culminating as Alderamin sets suggests spirituality and imagination at peak influenced by intellectual and communicative themes.
Pluto culminating as Saturn rises suggests transformation and power at peak influenced by structure and discipline themes.

setting_parans.description: Stars setting or planets at setting during birth

star_details.name: Spica (α Virginis)
star_details.meaning: The wheat sheaf. Great success, talents, gifts, but must avoid pride.

entries.interpretation: Sun setting as Spica rises suggests later years influenced by Spica's themes of success, talent, with caution about pride.

star_details.name: Zuben Eschamali (β Librae)
star_details.meaning: The northern claw. Artistic, sociable, but potential for unethical behavior.

entries.interpretation: Moon setting as Zuben Eschamali sets suggests emotional nature in later years influenced by artistic and social themes.
Mars setting as Mean Node rises suggests action and drive in later years influenced by karmic and destiny themes.

star_details.name: Markab (α Pegasi)
star_details.meaning: The saddle. Success through mental effort, but danger of violence or accidents.

entries.interpretation: Saturn setting as Markab culminates suggests discipline and structure in later years influenced by mental effort themes, with cautions.

star_details.name: Al Rescha (α Piscium)
star_details.meaning: The cord. Binding relationships, partnerships, but potential for entanglement.

entries.interpretation: Uranus setting as Al Rescha rises suggests individuality and innovation in later years influenced by relationship and binding themes.

star_details.name: Bellatrix (γ Orionis)
star_details.meaning: The female warrior. Success through combat (physical or verbal), but danger of quarrels.

entries.interpretation: Neptune setting as Bellatrix rises suggests spirituality and imagination in later years influenced by warrior-like themes.

star_details.name: Sirius (α Canis Majoris)
star_details.meaning: The scorching one. Great fame, ambition, leadership, but danger of overheating.

entries.interpretation: Neptune setting as Sirius rises suggests spirituality in later years influenced by themes of fame and ambition.

lower_culmination_parans.description: Stars at lower culmination (IC/nadir) during birth

star_details.name: Antares (α Scorpii)
star_details.meaning: Rival of Mars. Military success, exploration, but danger of violence or accidents.

entries.interpretation: Moon at lower culmination with Antares at lower culmination suggests emotional foundations influenced by Antares' martial and exploratory themes.
Mercury at lower culmination as Acumen sets suggests mental foundations influenced by pointed or penetrating themes.

star_details.name: Mirach (β Andromedae)
star_details.meaning: The girdle. Beauty, artistic talent, but potential for victimization.

entries.interpretation: Mars at lower culmination as Mirach sets suggests action foundations influenced by beauty and artistic themes.

star_details.name: Ras Alhague (α Ophiuchi)
star_details.meaning: Head of the serpent-holder. Healing ability, medical interests, but danger of poisoning.

entries.interpretation: Mars at lower culmination as Ras Alhague culminates suggests action foundations influenced by healing and medical themes.
Mars at lower culmination with Alnilam at lower culmination suggests action foundations doubly influenced by leadership and organizational themes.

star_details.name: Castor (α Geminorum)
star_details.meaning: The mortal twin. Skill in speaking, writing, commerce, but potential for duality or deception.

entries.interpretation: Pluto at lower culmination as Castor sets suggests transformation foundations influenced by communicative and commercial themes.

allt.description: The star is above the horizon only during daylight hours, invisible due to sunlight.
allt.astrological_meaning: Themes that emerge subtly or are hidden in early life, becoming visible later.

cp.description: The star is above the horizon all night: rises before sunset and sets after sunrise.
cp.astrological_meaning: Themes that are constantly present or have extended influence.

phase_definitions.calculation_note: Parans calculated for actual rise/set/culmination times on birth day, from preceding sunrise to following sunrise.
phase_definitions.underlined_objects: Objects underlined in original were at one of the four angles (Asc, Desc, MC, IC) at birth time.
